```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const container = DOM.element("div", { style: "height:460px;border-radius:6px;" });
  yield container;
  const map = L.map(container).setView([15, 10], 2);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
  }).addTo(map);
  places.forEach(p => {
    L.marker([p.lat, p.lng]).addTo(map).bindPopup(`<b>${p.name}</b><br>${p.note}`);
  });
}
```
